title: hieracium adelphicum
intro: Hieracium adelphicum, commonly known as hawkweed or lesser hawkbit, is a perennial plant belonging to the dandelion family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium adelphicum include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
